data.name: Dowmann
data.description: Dowmann is an Irish carbon removal company that transforms waste biomass into biochar, renewable fuel, and clean electricity via pyrolysis. It is a very lean startup with three full-time team members plus two remote workers, and is positioned to raise investment to establish its first production facility. It has used Puro.earth for carbon removal verification and participated in the EIT Climate-KIC Carbon Removal ClimAccelerator.
